authors_reviews.title: No Need to Over-Pack for Camping. Just Bring This Along.
authors_reviews.text: This is a fantastic product, not just for emergencies, but also so you don't have to over-pack for "just-in-case" situations. We took this on a boat to an overnight trip to an island. It did get chillier than expected so using this over our regular gear kept us very comfortable. And it is totally reusable as you can fold it back up and it will fit back in the case. Highly recommend.
authors_reviews.author: A. Gulbrandsen

authors_reviews.title: Must have if you want your family prepared for anything!!
authors_reviews.text: Especially in the Northeast we have to have a survival kit in our cars and houses during winter. These are so much more compact and easy to keep than any actual blanket and so much warmer. Getting stuck in a storm and power outages are a real issue we have to always be prepared for. My kids, mom, and I have them in all our vehicles and at home. I know my family is always ready no matter what!
authors_reviews.author: Jennifer Ball

authors_reviews.title: Great quality product. You definitely don't want to be left in the cold without one!
authors_reviews.text: I purchased these with the intention of sandwiching them between a fleece lap blanket to be used in our side-by-side! This works wonderfully! They hold heat better than anything I've ever used. They are windproof and also keep you dry. I also use it in the house on chilly nights. I can't believe how toasty you become in such a short amount of time. When you remove the blanket, the air feels so cold instantly! I will be purchasing again to make more blankets!
authors_reviews.author: S. Wilkinson

authors_reviews.title: A must product for a to-go bag
authors_reviews.text: I felt the price was very good. I have not opened it up. I have it for my to-go bag. I have quite a few of them actually. This brand and another the material seems good. Comes in a small little pack which is good for a to-go bag. I have one in my bag and one in my car. It appears to be very durable. Like I mentioned I have not had to use it yet. I feel more comfortable that I have one than not having one
authors_reviews.author: JODI SILVER

authors_reviews.title: Small enough to carry in my bike bag
authors_reviews.text: I got this 2 pack of rain covers just in case I get caught in a rain storm when I’m way out on a long ride on my e-bikes. Because you never know it could be clear out and nice when you head out but weather is unpredictable sometimes. I hope I never have to use them but if I do then they will help hopefully. I like how compact they are and it comes with a whistle not sure what I’ll use that for but hey you never know lol. They are light and the cost wasn’t bad at all.
